notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) building in-product assistants and enriched search. Trialed Hosted API for 3 weeks: infra + product team ran a sandbox with ~10k monthly active users. Primary interest now is moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost predictability.

Hosted API trial summary:
- Started 2024-10-14, initial integration finished 10/21.
- Generated ~2.1M tokens during trial (mix: 55% generation/chat, 30% embeddings for doc-search, 15% re-ranking/summarization).
- Observed avg latency (hosted): 230ms token-stream median; spikes at 95th pct to ~1.2s during bursts.
- UX feedback: product team flagged occasional tail latency causing degraded chat experience.

Current ask / evaluation focus:
- Dedicated sizing: need recommended GPU pool sizing for expected steady-state and burst windows (see traffic forecast below).
- Pricing: want committed monthly pricing for 3, 6, 12 month terms + overage rates. Prefer per-GPU-hour and per-token SLO billing options.
- Routing/fallback: require automated fallback to smaller model (cost tier) during capacity pressure and regional routing between NA/EU.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs for API calls, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Traffic forecast & capacity signals (provided by Sable Harvest infra lead):
- Active tenants: 320 (projected 420 in 6 months).
- Peak QPS observed during trial day: 38 QPS overall (spike window 10-12m). Expected peak QPS for production: 120 QPS sustained for 15m windows on launch.
- Concurrency: average concurrency 12 requests; peak concurrency estimated 48 (95th pct) during sales events.
- Token mix: average request token length = 450 tokens (prompt + response); token distribution: 60% short chats (<300 tokens), 25% long generation (>800 tokens), 15% embeddings/rerank (mostly fixed small vectors).
- Monthly token estimate for launch (month 1): 25M tokens; month 6 projection: 95M tokens.

POC milestones agreed:
- 11/21: Hosted trial retrospective (FF-2024-11-21-9821) — product + infra to align on SLOs.
- 11/28: Dedicated demo with metrics walkthrough (FF-2024-11-28-3105).
- By 12/06: Redwood to deliver Dedicated capacity proposal (recommended instance types, estimated GPU-hours, autoscale policies, caching strategies).
- By 12/13: Sable Harvest infra to run 48h soak test on Dedicated staging using Redwood-supplied config.

Model & performance preferences:
- Prefer Llama-family and mixed quant model variants for latency/cost. Open to Redwood-curated model bundle.
- Wants 95th pct latency SLO <= 600ms for chat token generation under typical traffic. For long generations, soft SLO of 1200ms per token window acceptable.
- Require embeddings to be run in the same region as tenant data for residency compliance.

Cost sensitivity & billing preferences:
- High sensitivity to per-token spend; prefer committed monthly capacity to reduce unit cost.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and KV caching to reduce per-token cost.

Decision criteria (stakeholders):
- CTO/Infra: cost per QPS/GPU-hour, autoscale/resilience, observability hooks.
- Head of Product: latency tail improvements, model quality (hallucination rates), rollout control (canary/A-B).
- Security/Legal: SOC2 evidence, data residency contract language, key management.

Quote from head of product (paraphrase): "We need predictable tail behavior during launch — can't have random latency spikes that break step-by-step assistants."

Open items / blockers:
- Legal needs data residency appendix for EU customers before signing.
- Pricing: need a 12-month committed quote with GPU sizing options; finance needs per-month burn estimates.
- Sizing: Redwood to validate that recommended GPU pool handles 120 QPS peak with 95th pct latency target.

Suggested next actions for AE/SE:
- Deliver detailed capacity proposal (GPU types, pool sizing, expected QPS per GPU) + cost for 3/6/12 month commits.
- Provide an SLO-backed performance matrix (median/95/99 latency) for recommended config using similar token mix.
- Share a templated data residency SLA and SOC2 page for Legal review.

Attachments / references:
- Drive: POC plan + trial logs (see linked_drive_docs).
- Jira: INF-2171 (requested a priority perf test), SEC-443 (legal questions on residency).

CRM notes tone: concise, many bullets, product/infrastructure centric. Follow-up is timeboxed — decision window early Jan.
